title: CLIVO: Differentiable Cluster-Based Instruction Mixing with Learned Validation Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2610.16876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Target-aware multimodal instruction selection requires useful examples and an appropriate balance of supervision. Sample-level rankings can overrepresent similar content without optimizing this balance; group-level methods face coarse units, predefined set-level validation signals, and costly or inaccurate mixture search. We propose CLIVO, a target-aware framework connecting fine-grained semantic allocation, automatically learned validation objectives, and differentiable mixture search. Specifically, semantic clusters provide independently adjustable shares at the hundred-cluster scale. Correlations between per-example merged-proxy losses and real probe performance identify target-relevant validation examples; learned nonnegative weights combine their losses into an objective. translated_title: CLIVO：基于可微分聚类的指令混合与学习式验证目标
translated_abstract: 面向目标的多模态指令选择既需要有用的样本，也需要监督信号的恰当平衡。样本级排序方法可能会过度代表相似内容，而无法优化这种平衡；组级方法则面临单元粒度过粗、依赖预定义的集合级验证信号、以及混合搜索代价高昂或不准确等问题。我们提出CLIVO，这是一个面向目标的框架，将细粒度语义分配、自动学习的验证目标与可微分混合搜索连接在一起。具体而言，语义聚类在数百个聚类的规模上提供可独立调整的份额。通过每个样本的合并代理损失与真实探测性能之间的相关性，识别与目标相关的验证样本；学习到的非负权重将这些样本的损失组合成一个目标函数。对合并代理进行单次反向传播即可为所有份额提供梯度，从而避免了额外的混合-响应回归模型。选择10万条指令……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: CLIVO提出了一种面向目标的多模态指令选择框架，通过细粒度语义聚类份额分配、自动学习的验证目标和可微分混合搜索，以单次反向传播高效优化指令数据混合比例。
en_tdlr: CLIVO proposes a target-aware multimodal instruction selection framework that integrates fine-grained semantic cluster allocation, automatically learned validation objectives, and differentiable mixture search, efficiently optimizing instruction mixing ratios with a single backward pass.
